cat_tensors: concatenate a list of CrypTensor objects along a specified dimension using the cat function
stack_tensors: stack a list of CrypTensor objects along a new dimension using the stack function
pad_tensor: pad a CrypTensor with a specified mode and value using the pad function
compute_dot_product: compute a weighted or unweighted dot product between two CrypTensors using the dot function
scatter_add_values: add values from one CrypTensor into another at specified indices using the scatter_add function
